messages:
Omar Ziad: Hey folks! Omar here — first day as a Platform Engineer (infra). Based in Lisbon (GMT+0), mostly remote but planning an office visit once a month. Big fan of good coffee, weekend hikes, and terrible foosball skills. :grin: Quick Q: what's the best sandwich/lunch spot near the office? Also what's the daily standup time?

Sylvia Park: Welcome Omar! :tada: Prego on 3rd is the move for sandwiches. Standup is 10:15 CET in #eng-platform. We'll add you to the standup rotation.

Jen (People Ops): Hi Omar — welcome to Redwood! :wave: Your onboarding checklist and benefits doc are in the welcome folder: https://intranet/redwood/welcome (DM me if anything's missing). 1:1 with Taylor is on your calendar Monday at 11.

Mike Rivera: Yo Omar — if you like espresso go for a short black at the cafe across the street. Friday foosball 4pm in the office if you ever make a visit. :table_tennis:

Taylor Nguyen: Hey Omar — I'm your onboarding buddy. Will ping you later about infra orientation and the codebase tour. Also re: lunch, we often order group lunches via the #lunch-plans channel.

Sara Lin: Also FYI we run "random coffee" pairings for remote folks every month — great way to meet people. Signups in #people-ops. :coffee:

dev-bot: account created for omar.ldap@redwood — GitHub invite sent, slack groups synced.

Omar Ziad: Thanks everyone — super excited to be here. I'll try Prego tomorrow and join the random coffee. Ping me anytime for pair debugging or a virtual ☕️. :rocket:
